title: Every finite partition of a topological space is refined by a finite stratification
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that every finite partition of a topological space is refined by a finite stratification (author lemma at source lines 5807-5811, label lemma-partition-refined-by-stratification). The proof (source lines 5813-5821) constructs the refinement explicitly: from each piece it forms the closure and the difference between the closure and the piece, and then takes the finite family of all intersections choosing one of the two for each index; the resulting non-empty members form a finite stratification refining the partition (proof lines 5814-5819). The lemma is the technical device by which the chapter passes from partitions to stratifications. H2.
